approved_classes.ex:AminoAcid: Amino acid, any of a group of organic molecules that contain a basic amino group (NH2) and an acidic carboxyl group (COOH).
approved_classes.ex:EssentialAminoAcid: Amino acid that is not produced by the body and must be obtained through food.
approved_classes.ex:NonEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acid that is produced by the body and does not require supplementation.
approved_classes.ex:SemiEssentialAminoAcid: Amino acid that is produced in the body but in insufficient amounts, requiring supplementation.
approved_classes.ex:BranchedChainAminoAcid: Amino acid with a branched aliphatic side chain.
approved_classes.ex:HydroxylGroupContainingAminoAcid: Amino acid with a hydroxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:SulphurContainingAminoAcid: Amino acid containing a sulfohydryl or thioether group.
approved_classes.ex:AcidicAminoAcid: Amino acid with a dicarboxylic monoamino structure.
approved_classes.ex:BasicAminoAcid: Amino acid with a dibasic monocarboxylic structure.
approved_classes.ex:AromaticAminoAcid: Amino acid with an aromatic ring.
approved_classes.ex:IminoAminoAcid: Amino acid with an imino group.
approved_classes.ex:HeterocyclicAminoAcid: Amino acid with a heterocyclic ring.
approved_classes.ex:AlphaAminoAcid: Amino acid with the amino group attached to the next carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:BetaAminoAcid: Amino acid with the amino group attached to the third carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:GammaAminoAcid: Amino acid with the amino group attached to the fourth carbon of the carboxyl group.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyKetogenicAminoAcid: Amino acid that can be used to make fat and is transformed into ketone bodies.
approved_classes.ex:KetogenicAndGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acid that can be metabolized into both ketogenic and glucogenic pathways.
approved_classes.ex:PurelyGlucogenicAminoAcid: Amino acid that can be used as a starting point for glucose or glycogen production.
approved_classes.ex:NonPolarAminoAcid: Amino acid with no charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNoChargeOnRGroup: Amino acid with an uncharged 'R' group but with groups like hydroxyl, sulfhydryl, and amide.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithPositiveChargeOnRGr: Amino acid with a positive charge on the 'R' group.
approved_classes.ex:PolarAminoAcidWithNegativeChargeOnRGr: Amino acid with a negative charge on the 'R' group.
